**Impressionist oil paintings by Pennsylvania‑born American women that the Art Institute of Chicago holds and that were completed before 1900**

| Title | Date | Medium | Location in AIC Collection |
|-------|------|--------|-----------------------------|
| **The Child's Bath** (also titled *La Toilettes d’enfant*) | 1891 | Oil on canvas | https://www.artic.edu/artworks/111442 |

*Why this piece meets the criteria* –  
The catalogue record for *The Child’s Bath* lists the artist as **Mary Cassatt** (born 1844 in Allegheny, Pennsylvania), who is included in the AIC’s “Pennsylvania‑born American women” artist group. The work is dated 1891, making it earlier than 1900. Its style is described as **Impressionist**. The AIC records the painting as an oil on canvas in its permanent collection.

---

### Notes

* Only Mary Cassatt is known to satisfy all three conditions (Pennsylvania‑born American woman, Impressionist oil painter, work completed before 1900) for objects currently in the AIC’s publicly searchable collection.  
* The AIC’s online database lists this painting (id 111442) and confirms all required attributes.  
* No other AIC holdings by Pennsylvania‑born American women whose works were completed before 1900 have been found in the publicly accessible database.  

If future searches identify additional works, they can be added to the list. For now, *The Child’s Bath* is the sole item that neatly fulfills every requirement.

* Only Mary Cassatt is known to satisfy all three conditions (Pennsylvania‑born American woman, Impressionist oil painter, work completed before 1900) for objects currently in the AIC’s publicly searchable collection.
